summary: V495 ships Lift lending as a dark-launch pallet (Enabled defaults false): escrowed short/long loans with root-settable LiftParams, a 30-day max loan duration and roll, continuous thin-depth blend for capacity floor and long LTV, realized expiry AMM slippage bounds with fair Expiry/ExpiryRetry budgeting, and freeze-forever settlement when the band cannot clear.
